_doc: FX scene promises: scenes of Lumitra FX, the WebGL effects engine, that an FX scene box must keep (docs/plans/2026-11-08-lumitra-fx-in-sites.md, slice F4). One row per reference scene. Format: the strict reader gives exactly the scene the engine's own loader gives, with nothing repaired, and storing it again changes nothing. Renderer: this app draws the same pixels as the engine as lumitra-web runs it (test/fx-oracle). Canvas: on the real editor nothing is drawn by default, and with Live on the scene is drawn in exactly one WebGL context, filling the box behind its content (slice F5). Panel: pasted into the FX section the scene is stored unchanged, and every setting of every layer has a control (slice F5). AI: written in the taught preset form the scene comes through the generator's validator unchanged, one retuned setting changes only that setting, and an invented layer is left out with a note (slice F6).
